description: This Java class 'ReadingGoalService' provides service layer functionality for managing reading goals in the book project. It interacts with the 'ReadingGoalRepository' to perform CRUD operations, enforce constraints (such as only one goal at a time), and offers methods for finding, saving, deleting, and counting reading goals.

classes.name: ReadingGoalService
classes.description: Service class managing reading goals, allowing CRUD operations with specific logic to maintain only a single goal at a time.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a ReadingGoal by its ID.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all reading goals.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a new reading goal, overwriting the previous one if any.

methods.name: overwritePreviouslySetGoal
methods.description: Deletes all existing goals and saves the new goal, ensuring only one goal exists.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of reading goals (expected to be 0 or 1).
